intro: Lesson 35: Important Lessons unit 4: minor and hidden shirk. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Case
Problem? Which kind? The fix
rows: A pupil reads Qur'an loudly only when guests come.
A donor posts a photo of their charity receipt online.
A boy says 'I swear by my life'.
A girl prays very fast when she is alone but slowly when people watch.

blocks.answers: 1. Risk of riya' (minor shirk); fix the intention and read for Allah whether or not people listen. 2. Risk of riya'; give secretly where possible, for Allah alone. 3. Minor shirk (swearing by other than Allah); swear only by Allah. 4. Carelessness and riya' risk; pray calmly for Allah in every place.

passage.title: Summary of a hadith of Abu Hurayrah (Muslim)
paras: The first to be judged on the Day of Resurrection include a man who fought, a man who learnt and taught, and a man who gave charity, each doing it to be praised.

panels.title: Guarding ikhlas
points: Do not stop good deeds for fear of riya'

keywords.def: minor shirk: does not take one out of Islam but is a grave sin
showing off: doing worship to be seen

questions.q: Explain the difference between major and minor shirk.
questions.a: Major shirk is worship given to other than Allah and takes one out of Islam; minor shirk (like riya' or swearing by other than Allah) does not, but is a grave sin.

questions.q: Case studies on the pupil PDF: four short scenarios (a pupil reading Qur'an loudly when guests come, a donor posting a receipt, a boy swearing by his life, a girl praying fast when alone). For each: is there a problem, which kind, and what is the fix? Answer in the portal response box.
questions.a: Riya' risk, fix with intention; riya' risk, give secretly where possible; minor shirk, swear by Allah; carelessness, pray calmly for Allah

questions.q: Extend: why should we not stop a good deed for fear of showing off?
questions.a: Shaytan wants us to stop; fix the intention instead
A) Minor shirk. Swearing by other than Allah is minor shirk; swear by Allah or keep silent.

questions.q: Minor shirk ... take a person out of Islam.
Think again: where is the line with praise?
questions.a: Doing the deed for the praise is riya'; feeling glad afterwards is not
